summary: An employer shifts staff at {workplace} toward delivering goods as on-site purchases fall.
realLife: Members heard that expanding deliveries in place of selling on the premises helped some firms retain employees during the slowdown.
gates: The record identifies the change in on-site sales and delivery assignments.
inGame: needs: change in on-site sales and delivery assignments.

turns.what: The employer retains the workers on those shifts.
turns.writesBack: Delivery shifts on the new roster.

turns.what: The employer reopens its staffing decision.
turns.writesBack: Uncovered shifts on the staffing plan.
